results.title: Foreigners in Nigeria's retail market, what the law says
results.snippet:
One of the items sold in a Chinese-owned store in Abuja is a toilet and bathroom cleaner, a product also manufactured locally in Nigeria. Picture used for illustrative purposes.

Similarly, the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act (FCCPA) 2018 regulates anti-competitive behaviour and abuse of market dominance but does not reserve retail trade exclusively for Nigerian citizens. [...] ###
